         1                  This measure was introduced at the

         2       request of the Office of Court Administration,

         3       and it will require that persons who wish to

         4       transfer a structured settlement to another

         5       party do so by an order to show cause, and to

         6       also provide a statement as to whether there

         7       have been any transfers or applications for

         8       transfer of the structured settlement.

         9                  And finally, this legislation

        10       requires that the payee shall attend before

        11       the court unless attendance is excused for

        12       good cause by the court with judicial consent.

        13       However, the payee must attend before the

        14       court either by video conferencing, by

        15       telephone, or, as I said before, if in the

        16       order to show cause they make the request that

        17       they not appear, it is done by judicial

        18       consent.
